best_ability.scaling: 100 base damage · ×1.0 per Spirit Power (the slam) — the lift is the point; read the note
best_ability.why: Wraith is a gun carry: Card Trick's spirit damage is a rounding error (×0.045 per bullet). Her one real spirit-scaling hit is Telekinesis — 100 base, ×1.0 on the slam — and the lift itself is the best pick tool in her kit. So this NUKE supercharges the lift: cooldown stacking and Refresher for double lifts, with enough spirit that the slam genuinely hurts. It is a playmaker build, not a damage nuke — her gun still does the killing.

nuke.kit_synergy: Every imbue goes on Telekinesis. The lift decides fights; this build makes sure it's always ready.
